description.value: Payabli is a payments infrastructure company for software companies, founded in 2020 and headquartered in Miami. Its main offering is a single API that lets software platforms accept payments, send payouts, and manage payment operations inside their own products.
Payabli is a payments infrastructure company for software platforms.

product_description.value: A single API that lets software platforms accept payments, send payouts, and manage payment operations. Developers can also use no-code components such as Payabli Creator.

Pay In: accepting payments online and in person, through wallets, bill pay, lockbox and remote deposit capture, invoicing, and payment links. Pay Out: managed payables, on-demand payouts, spend management, and a vendor portal. Pay Ops: merchant boarding, pricing and billing, risk and underwriting, and reporting. Also AI offerings, including agentic commerce built with Visa and the Amigo AI agent suite.

business_model_description.value: Revenue-share and flexible pricing and billing tools. Pricing is not published; the company asks prospects to contact it for details.

customer_description.value: Target markets are SaaS companies, financial institutions, tech-enabled services, and enterprise merchants. Named customer: Builder Prime.
Worked with 60+ software companies as of June 2024, according to one profile. Other sources say it works with hundreds of partners.
